response.title: which 1000w portable power station lasts the longest
response.answer:
For a 1000W portable power station, the one that lasts the longest depends on what you mean by lasts:

Longest runtime per charge: Look for the highest battery capacity (Wh), not just the 1000W output rating.

Longest battery lifespan: Look for LiFePO4 (LFP) batteries rated for 3,000–4,000+ charge cycles.

Longest runtime at a continuous 1000W load: A 1,000Wh power station typically runs for only 45–55 minutes because of inverter losses.

I'll compare models that can deliver at least 1000W continuously, focusing on battery capacity and longevity.
